crossRefs.note: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him…
They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing…
But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t…
They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge…
saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your…
forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them…
I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
Therefore if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not…

parallels.note: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him…

translations.web: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”
translations.bsb: “Master,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”
translations.kjv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
translations.asv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followeth not with us.
